anomalies.description: A man with long hair aims two handguns directly at the camera; muzzle flash and recoil are visible in frames f0 and f3, indicating active firing.
A man forcefully grabs a woman by the hair and pulls her head down (f1–f2), indicating an attack on a vulnerable person in a non-consensual, aggressive manner.

A violent physical struggle occurs between two men on a street: one grabs the other from behind (f2), they grapple while one holds a gun (f8–f11), and the struggle ends with one man subdued against a wall (f12).
Sparks fly upward from the pavement near a man’s feet (f4–f5), consistent with bullet impacts on concrete; the man reacts as if struck or startled by gunfire.

Two individuals are engaged in a close-quarters physical struggle; one is holding the other in a chokehold or bear hug while the latter struggles and holds a pistol, with dynamic motion and facial expressions indicating active combat.

A woman lies motionless on the ground, appearing injured or unconscious, with visible distress and dishevelment (f12–f14); this follows the prior assault and struggle, suggesting she is a helpless victim of violence.

After the initial struggle, the man appears to overpower the woman, who is now limp and being forcibly held down; his expression is aggressive and she shows signs of distress, suggesting non-consensual control or assault.; The woman lies on the ground, visibly distressed and struggling, while the man looms over her with a weapon (pistol) in hand; she is in a vulnerable position and appears to be resisting or reacting to imminent threat, indicating ongoing abuse.; A person is repeatedly attacked while lying on the ground; includes being held down, having a gun pressed to their head, and being shot. The victim is clearly helpless and unable to resist.
Initial physical struggle where one person is bent over another on the ground; hands are engaged in close contact, suggesting mutual grappling before the victim becomes fully subdued.

A visible muzzle flash and dust/explosion cloud erupts from the vicinity of the woman’s hands as she lies prone, consistent with a firearm being discharged at close range (likely a handgun), causing a burst of smoke/dust and her immediate recoil.

A person in dark clothing is seen holding a handgun to the head of a prone, helpless victim lying on the ground, then pressing the gun against the victim's neck and chest area while the victim struggles weakly.
The victim is shown with fresh blood erupting from the neck and face, consistent with a close-range gunshot wound; the gun is no longer visible but the immediate aftermath is captured.
The attacker (in light top) is seen standing over the injured victim, who is now upright but disoriented and clutching their neck/chest, suggesting continued coercion or post-assault control.
A woman supports a severely injured man with blood on his face and shirt; he appears limp and unresponsive, suggesting he has been attacked and is now helpless.

The man’s injuries (facial blood, disheveled appearance) and the woman’s alarmed expression suggest recent physical combat occurred just before or during this interval, though direct combat is not visible in these frames.
A person lies motionless on the floor inside a doorway while two individuals stand over them, indicating a possible assault or aftermath of violence against a helpless victim.
